description: Check the credit balance, plan, and status for a Revternal API key — free, does not consume credits. Use before a bulk search/enrichment run to confirm you have credits, or to diagnose a "HTTP 402 Payment Required" error from another revternal_* tool. Requires your own Revternal API key (BYOK) — pass it as _apiKey. Example: revternal_credit_balance({ _apiKey: "..." }).

_apiKey.description: Your Revternal API key (sent as x-api-key), from https://revternal.com/signup. Required — Pipeworx has no platform key for this pack.

name: revternal_credit_balance
